name: Unitree Aliengo
summary: An older mid-size Unitree research quadruped of about 21 kg with depth cameras, open C/C++ and ROS interfaces and room for own payloads such as a lidar or a small arm. Unitree still lists it among its industry robots.

germany.statusNote: QUADRUPED Robotics (Bergheim, Germany) lists the QUADRUPED Aliengo at 40,235 € excl. VAT with an add-to-cart button; made to order, about 21 days after the order. MYBOTSHOP lists it with price on request.
